machines.title: Turkish Cow & Buffalo Milking Machines
machines.subtitle: Built tough for Pakistani farm conditions. Tested on Sahiwal cows, Cholistani breeds, and Nili-Ravi buffaloes.

singleBucket.badge: Ideal for Small to Mid-Sized Herds
singleBucket.name: Single-Bucket Turkish Milking Machine
singleBucket.targetHerd: Best for herds of 5 to 15 cows or buffaloes
singleBucket.description: Milks one animal at a time with steady, gentle vacuum pressure. Compact cart with heavy-duty rubber wheels makes it easy for one worker to maneuver through stalls.

doubleCluster.name: Double-Cluster / Dual-Bucket Milking Machine
doubleCluster.targetHerd: Best for herds of 15 to 40+ cows or buffaloes
doubleCluster.description: Milks two animals simultaneously. Features a high-flow vacuum pump, heavy reinforcement frame, and large surge tank to prevent pressure drops during animal movement.

tools.title: Essential Dairy Farm Tools & Hygiene Supplies
tools.subtitle: High-grade accessories designed to keep milk clean and maintain animal udder health.

items.name: Non-Return Teat Dip Cup
items.desc: Prevents mastitis by applying antiseptic before and after milking. Non-return valve prevents backwash into the supply reservoir.

items.name: Stainless Steel Milk Cans
items.desc: Heavy-gauge 20L, 30L, and 50L food-grade transport cans with hermetic lockable lids and dual carry handles.

items.name: Milking Cluster Assembly
items.desc: Original Turkish 4-cup cluster assembly with transparent silicone shells, rubber milk tubes, and 240cc claw.

items.name: Milk Strainer with Micro-Filter
items.desc: Seamless stainless steel funnel with reusable fine mesh insert to remove debris and dirt before chilling.

items.name: Calf Feeding Bucket with Nipple
items.desc: Graduated feeding pail equipped with durable rubber teat for measured milk feeding of calves.

items.name: Flexible Tube & Liner Cleaning Brushes
items.desc: Extra-long wire bristle brushes designed to scrub the interior of milk tubes and silicone liners daily.
